integrationsDesc: Connect external services using local, user-managed credentials.
googleWorkspaceDescription: Use Gmail, Calendar, and Drive through the local Google Workspace CLI.
googleWorkspaceDesktopOnly: Set up this integration in the Kun desktop app.
googleWorkspacePermissions: Connecting requests permission to read and modify Gmail, manage Calendar events, and read Drive files. Review these permissions in Google before approving. Google also requests your basic profile and email address.
googleWorkspaceCredentialOwnership: gws manages local credential files. Its encryption key may use the OS keyring or a local key file. Existing gws storage settings apply; Kun never asks you to paste client secrets or tokens.
googleWorkspaceTestDescription: Test connection makes small read-only requests to each service. It does not send mail, create events, or change files.
googleWorkspaceSetupTitle: Set up your Google OAuth client
googleWorkspaceSetupDescription: This experimental integration needs your own Google Cloud project and Desktop app OAuth client. Kun cannot create these automatically.
googleWorkspaceSetupStep1: In your Google Cloud project, enable the Gmail, Calendar, and Drive APIs.
googleWorkspaceSetupStep2: Configure the OAuth consent screen. For an External app in testing, add your Google account as a test user.
googleWorkspaceSetupStep3: Create a Desktop app OAuth client and save the downloaded JSON directly to ~/.config/gws/client_secret.json. Then refresh and connect.
googleWorkspaceSetupTerminal: Alternatively, run gws auth setup yourself in an interactive terminal with gcloud installed. Do not paste credentials into Kun.
googleWorkspaceCloseCancels: Leaving this page cancels the operation started here. Complete Google consent in your browser, or choose Cancel.
googleWorkspaceStatusError: Could not check Google Workspace status. Check that Kun is running and try Refresh.
googleWorkspacePollError: Could not update the operation or open the Google sign-in page. Cancel and try again if this continues.
googleWorkspaceActionError: The Google Workspace action could not complete. Refresh to check its status, or cancel before retrying.
googleWorkspaceCancelError: Cancellation could not be confirmed. Try Cancel again before starting another operation.
googleWorkspaceDisconnectConfirm: Remove local gws credentials and caches? This may disconnect other tools that use gws. It does not revoke access in your Google account; remove that consent separately in Google account settings.
